bullets.text: Built an NLP service powered by large language models to draft three reply options for every customer review, incorporating sentiment analysis and dealership rules; clients select one to publish, with roughly 93% of drafts published unedited across more than 100k monthly customer feedback reviews overall.

Fine-tuned Llama 3 8B using Python with LoRA and QLoRA Unsloth on text examples generated by a 70B model, distilling its ability to follow strict client wording rules while maintaining low cost and fast speed.

Deployed the Python service on AWS EC2, configuring NVIDIA drivers and Linux environments from scratch, then led migration to an on-prem GPU server and built database caching for repeat requests to cut costs and response times.
